author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
After finding a set of heavy duty clear plastic bins on a recent trip to IKEA, Adam attempts to integrate them into his shop organization with a quick storage rack build. It's the perfect excuse to consolidate all the leatherworking supplies scattered throughout the cave in various drawers and cubbies. 

Adam Savage's leatherworking toolbox: https://youtu.be/Vxko8OhUv7s
IKEA Samla plastic bins: https://www.ikea.com/us/en/p/samla-box-with-lid-clear-s29440819/
